FN-CU8IJJJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 177
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Sells
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/19/2024
House Bill 177 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Commerce,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2024, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in (1)
the current salary of the Secretary of Commerce and deputy secretaries; and (2) any new salaries
set pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/15/2024
House Bill 177 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the obligations of the
Department of Commerce, beginning in Fiscal Year 2024, by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the difference in (1) the current salary of the Secretary of Commerce and deputy
secretaries; and (2) any new salaries set pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
